prompts.image2d: Use case: style-transfer. Create a TWO-DIMENSIONAL HAND-DRAWN character turnaround from image 1, not a CG image or filtered photograph. Image 1 is authoritative for this exact character's identity, face, mature age direction, proportions, pose, costume, colors, accessories, limb count and all three view details. Image 2 is ONLY a drawing-style reference: refined controlled dark ink linework, subtle line weight, restrained cel color blocks, soft illustrated volume and fine faint paper texture. Do not copy bull identity horns or clothes from image 2. Preserve the original species and existing degree of anthropomorphism, not a redesign. Landscape 3:2 sheet: left full front, center full side, right full back, same scale and baseline, ample margins including full antennae/antlers/wing tips/feet. Warm pale beige paper backdrop with subtle drawn contact shadow. Crisp detailed line-art drawn fur/feathers and fabric folds, clearly non-photoreal and non-3D. No labels text watermark panels scenery extra people. Cream curly wool sheep assembly worker, gray muzzle, pale blue-gray factory cap and uniform, blank badge, anti-static right wrist strap, articulated hoof-hands and dark shoes, short wool tail.
prompts.image3d: Use case: stylized-concept. AstralPact animal-world character design. Create ONE landscape 3:2 character turnaround sheet of the SAME character: left front view, center side view, right back view, equal scale, aligned feet, complete head feet tail and wings with generous space. Plain warm light gray beige studio backdrop, natural contact shadow. Image 1 is ONLY rendering quality reference: high-end feature-film 3D CGI, physically based materials, crisp natural detail, soft key and subtle cool fill; do NOT copy dragon identity, horns, jewelry or royal clothes. Image 2 ONLY reference for series anthropomorphic working-person proportions, practical worn clothing and three-view presentation; do NOT copy pigeon species, helmet or courier backpack. Mature dignified everyday worker, expressive animal face, not baby/chibi, not caricature of stupidity or misery. Fine individual fur/feathers where appropriate, woven cloth, believable seams and restrained material highlights. All three angles consistent anatomy clothing accessories. No text, labels, logos, watermark, scenery, extra characters. Adult anthropomorphic sheep factory assembly-line worker, cream curly wool, dark gray muzzle and ears, no large horns, slim average adult build, ordinary focused gentle expression. Pale blue-gray zip-front factory uniform and matching trousers, simple soft factory cap, blank clipped employee badge, anti-static wrist strap on right wrist, practical dark enclosed work shoes, small short sheep tail visible. Light cuff wear, no expensive accessories. Hands articulated sheep-derived hooves usable for work, not human skin.
